chapter: The Melody Inn and the Mighty Four
title: Crowds at the Melody Inn and why it closed
summary: Musicians and packed crowds came; the owner had a heart attack, sold the place and died, and the band moved to Happy Land.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
